summary: Sixteen days to the FreightWorks Expo (Nov 4). Maya declared Smart Slots the company-wide focus. Ranking (TW-116) gates the scoring API; final screens (TW-118) gate the picker UI. Sync errors are at 1.6%, above the 1% target. Harbor QBR is Thursday and the renewal looks routine.

items.text: Maya decided Smart Slots is the priority for everyone until the Nov 4 Expo; no side quests. Sync errors and the Harbor export limit wait until after Expo unless sync gets worse.
Arjun cannot wire real recommendations into the scoring endpoint (passes on test data) until Nina's ranking is done.
Nina committed to deliver the recommendation ranking by Wednesday (Oct 21); Arjun asked for it by then. Ticket due Oct 27.
Leila is building the slot picker on placeholder screens and needs Sam's final designs to finish.
Sam promised the final slot picker screens today by 3pm, then starts the Expo demo flow.
Coastal can go live once the API is stable. Valley is still sorting out data access on its side. Both need API docs (TW-127, due Oct 26).
Only two design partners are signed (Coastal, Valley); the third, Pinecrest Grocers, is not yet signed. Goal needs 3 live by launch.
Arjun created TW-127, API docs for Coastal and Valley, due Oct 26.
Jordan asked Nina for Q3 usage numbers for Harbor's QBR deck (TW-128); Nina agreed to deliver by tomorrow, Oct 21.
Jordan is building the Harbor QBR deck for Thursday Oct 22. Harbor renewal order form went out Friday; Dana said it should be routine. Renewal date Oct 30.
Sync error rate was 1.6% on Oct 18, above the 1% target, mostly Ridgeline duplicates. Deferred until after Expo unless it worsens. Ridgeline renews Nov 20, health yellow.
Harbor asked again about the 5,000-row CSV export limit (weekly export is about 7,000 rows). Jordan told them it is on the list; deferred until after Expo.
Maya has a booth design review with Sam on Wednesday; Expo invites go out Friday. Nina is on call this week.
No postmortem yet for Harbor's Sep 28 outage (41 appointments lost); TW-101 is open and unstarted, while Harbor's renewal is due Oct 30.
